name: nyoncode/wire-boost
description: AI tooling for the Wire ecosystem – an MCP server, AI guidelines and agent skills for the whole wireStack: core, forms, tables, sortable, panels, the admin shell and the ready-made modules.

suggest.nyoncode/wire-forms: Enables form introspection tools, guidelines and skills.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-table: Enables table introspection tools, guidelines and skills.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-panels: Enables resource/page introspection (describe-resource reports their surfaces), guidelines and skills.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-admin: Enables admin shell guidelines and skills (the layout, the sidebar, the chrome regions).
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-users: Enables module guidelines and skills; describe-module reports what it registers.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-auth: Enables module guidelines and skills; describe-module reports what it registers.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-settings: Enables module guidelines and skills; describe-module reports what it registers.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-audit: Enables module guidelines and skills; describe-module reports what it registers.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-notifications: Enables module guidelines and skills; describe-module reports what it registers.
suggest.nyoncode/wire-module-media: Enables module guidelines and skills; describe-module reports what it registers.
